bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are permitted after search; screening is required at entry.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking costs $25 in advance or $30 on show day and is first come first served in surrounding lots 1–4. The venue also sells North and South Lot upgrades.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not designate a specific rideshare loading point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drink are generally prohibited, with a special picnic exception on designated Picnic Series concerts. The venue is cashless and can convert cash to a card at Guest Services.
allowed: Picnic items at designated Picnic Series shows
prohibited: Outside food and drinks at ordinary concerts
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking and arrival information is available from the venue; use the event page to find the applicable gate and request staff assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is prohibited at regular events. Picnic Nights are an exception allowing guests to return picnic supplies to their vehicles.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is at the venue Ticket Office; bring photo ID and the purchasing card. On concert days the office opens at 2 p.m. and closes at 9 p.m.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Gates open at a show-specific time shown on the event detail page; patrons pass through a magnetometer and may request alternative hand screening.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
